comment: Checked-in floor on passing (SDK, fixture-or-scenario) cells, same trick as spec/fixtures/COUNTS.json (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 5). The runner fails if a run's actual PASS count for a key present here, and actually exercised by that run, drops below its floor -- see main.go's checkCounts. Observed with: full spec/fixtures/sequences + conformance/scenarios corpus present after the 2026-08-27 fix-round pass that made an OPEN above drain's last_stream_id connection-fatal PROTOCOL_ERROR (was a stream-scoped REFUSED_STREAM), go SDK built with -tags conformance, js SDK via conformance/adapters/js/adapter.mjs, --time-scale default (1/50). go-client rose from 23 to 24: drain_then_open_above_last_stream_id now passes against the Go client (go/wsmixer/dispatch.go's handleRemoteOpen). js-client now also rises to 24: the equivalent JS SDK change (js/src/conn.ts rejecting a post-drain OPEN above last_stream_id with a connection-fatal PROTOCOL_ERROR) had landed by this observation, and the stale step-driving.json override that assumed the old stream-scoped REFUSED_STREAM shape was removed, so the fixture now passes against the JS client too -- full matrix run confirmed 82 passed/0 failed/20 skipped. go-server/go->go/go->js are unchanged (19/7/8): go->go stays 7 because drain_reconnect's go->go cell is a structural SKIP (go/wsmixer's client has no reconnect loop by design), not a floor-eligible PASS.
